title: 2026 AI Inference & Hardware Economics Telemetry
subtitle: 58 Cluster Configs: NVIDIA B200, H100, TPU v5p, Trainium2 TCO & KV-Cache
description:
Official open-access empirical telemetry dataset on 2026 AI Inference, Silicon Architecture, and Hardware Economics by EyesTech Systems Lab (https://eyestech.in).

Canonical Research Investigation & Full Methodology:
https://eyestech.in/ai-inference-hardware-economics-statistics-tco-2026/

Key Metrics Recorded:
- 58 Bare-Metal Hardware Accelerator Configurations (H100 SXM5, B200 NVL, TPU v5p, Trainium2, MI300X)
- Serving Frameworks: vLLM (FlashAttention-3 + PagedAttention), TensorRT-LLM (FP8/FP4), Triton, Google MaxText
- Tokens per Joule, Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), Time Per Output Token (TPOT)
- Key-Value Cache HBM allocation at 128k context across MHA, GQA, and DeepSeek MLA
